title: Owner: Update now shows the updater's status in Health
goal: A real Update now on NERV-01 shows the updater's progress and outcome beside the button, after a reload too, until dismissed
acceptance: Update now on NERV-01 shows "Update in progress" with its step, then "Update completed · now on <sha>" (or refused/failed with reasons and recovery) under the Update availability row
A reload keeps the status; Dismiss hides it and it stays hidden after a reload
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: Owner-observed check on NERV-01: the Health row and ~/.nerv/updater-status.json
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 in the reconciliation: one Update now, a reload and Dismiss. Not a measurement. 2026-11-26: the updater-status.json and inbox half moved to B-123-T03 (agent, read-only), owner-step triage.
